title: Hello, I dream of the mallworld often, here is my last dream
content: I parked my car at a certain parking level, go to the elevators to the main mall and head over to the gamblers boutique. On my way there I find crazy good deals on clothing but I needed my money to gamble. I went to the machines and found an exploit that made me win for the entire night. When it gets late, thugs come out. I had forgotten where I parked my car due to gambling so long, and got lost in the shady part of the mall. I ran into the “drug dealers” that tried to pick pocket me, and met girls that took me home to some apartments. We ended up becoming really good friends, and went to the balcony for a smoke, we were all 3 on the balcony, but it has no guardrails. I left in a hurry and got my chain snatched by some massive drug dealer thug leader, Went to my car and it was totally scrapped. ———————————————————————— The time before that it was a huge party everywhere, there was a hotel section full of people and the only room available was on the 113’s floor. The elevator is made out of a cheese grater. Upstairs is a single room but staff runs through it at all times. Anyone else?
